analogy.rationale: PRSS1 and TPSAB1 are pancreatic/tryptase serine proteases with restricted expression in these cell lines, so serine protease inhibitors should elicit little to no transcriptional response; other protease or protein-targeting classes are listed only as weak/low-similarity alternatives since no class shares a relevant downstream program.
